content.text:
Dana, the plain answer is **probably yes, production changed, and it wasn't me.**

**What changed.** 13 customers were deleted, along with all their data: 45 invoices and 13 subscriptions. The missing customer IDs are 9, 13, 70, 82, 88, 92, 125, 136, 140, 145, 176, 177 and 198. They were real, active accounts: each has about 560 entries in the audit log. The dashboard now shows 201 customers, $68,949 MRR and 56 open invoices. Nothing else has changed. The schema is the same, migration 004 was never applied (there's still no `tax_id` column), and no rows were inserted or updated.

**When, and by whom.** I can't fully answer this. The database's own counters show the deletes happened after the last base backup and stats reset, at 13:19:10 UTC by the server clock. I can't link that time to your 6:02pm announcement, so I can't strictly prove the deletes came after the freeze started. There's also no record of who did it: statement logging is off, and the app's audit log has nothing from that time. Right now the only connection to the database is mine.

**Can we get it back?** Probably, but I can't confirm it. WAL archiving is on and hasn't had a single failure, and there's a base backup from 13:19:10 UTC. The runbook says ops creates a named restore point when a freeze starts. If they did, ops can restore the base backup and replay to that restore point. That puts production back exactly as it was at the freeze, deleted rows included. I can't see restore points from SQL, so ops needs to confirm it exists. They should restore to a copy first and check that the 13 customers are back before switching over. Any real customer activity since the freeze would be lost, but I see none.

**What I did myself.** I didn't run anything that changes production, and I didn't try to. Last night my shell access was denied, so I couldn't even read the database, and I never ran migration 004. This morning I ran only read-only queries (`select`, `\d`) to answer you.

Before the demo, ask everyone with database access whether they deleted these customers. Don't make any more changes until ops has restored or decided not to.
